shots.camera: straight-on eye-level camera on two matched frames standing side by side, small block pair cropped at the lower left corner as the only product presence
shots.lighting: even high-key cool 6500K from the upper right with a broad bounce from camera left, flat readable frame shadows, no drama
shots.background: #CFEAD9 field carrying two #FFFFFF bordered frames with a hairline #2E3A35 rule inset
shots.props: two loose unit blocks at the lower left corner only
shots.textZone: centered headline above the frames, one placeholder line under each frame
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic credential slot screen for {product} on a #CFEAD9 field: two matched #FFFFFF document frames standing side by side, each bordered by a hairline #2E3A35 inset rule and left completely blank inside so the seller can composite real paperwork in post. {product_identity_lock}. Preserve the exact product identity from the reference image: shape, silhouette, proportions, color, material, surface finish, label/logo placement, and visible construction details. Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level camera on the two frames, equal spacing on the centered vertical axis. Even high-key cool 6500K from the upper right with a broad bounce from camera left and flat readable frame shadows. Centered headline 「{callout_15}」 at 36pt in #2E3A35 with a short #4E9B85 rule above the frames and one subline 「{callout_16}」 at 16pt; one placeholder line 「{callout_17}」 at 12pt sits under each frame. The frames stay empty: no lettering, no emblem, no signature, no stamp. Two loose unit blocks sit cropped at the lower left corner as the only product presence. The frames occupy 50-60% of the frame. Negative: do not generate any certificate body text, serial number, lab number, seal, crest, stamp, barcode or QR code; do not name any standard such as EN71, ASTM, 3C or CE; no test report, award, rating or sales figure; no safety or eco conclusion; no age grade; no IQ or developmental-benefit wording; no hands, no faces, no watermark, no fake logo.
shots.negativePrompt: no certificate body text, serial number, lab number, seal, crest, stamp, barcode or QR code, no standard named (EN71, ASTM, 3C, CE), no test report, award, rating or sales figure, no safety or eco conclusion, no age grade, no IQ or developmental-benefit wording, no hands, no faces, no watermark, no fake logo

shots.title: 规格表收口按钮屏
shots.intent: 详情页最后一屏把到货内容与参数一次摊平，用 90 度平铺加空值规格表和一个明确按钮把看完的犹豫收成交付动作。
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, full kit spaced on a clean grid at the left, spec table at the right
shots.lighting: even high-key cool 6500K flat light from above with a slight bounce from camera left, minimal contact shadows, identical light on every piece
shots.background: #FFFFFF field with one #CFEAD9 spec panel at the right and a rounded button filled {accent_color}
shots.props: one unbranded plain storage bag or box and one plain insert sheet with no legible lettering
shots.textZone: spec panel with six generic field rows carrying placeholder values, centered headline above, rounded CTA button under the table
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic specification and close screen of {product}: the whole kit spaced on a clean grid under a 90-degree overhead camera, long blocks, cubes, cylinders and house shapes laid out in rows beside the drilled base board, one unbranded plain storage bag and one plain insert sheet carrying no legible lettering. {product_identity_lock}. Preserve the exact product identity from the reference image: shape, silhouette, proportions, color, material, surface finish, label/logo placement, and visible construction details. Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, kit at the left on a #FFFFFF field, one #CFEAD9 spec panel at the right. Even high-key cool 6500K flat light from above with a slight bounce from camera left, minimal contact shadows, identical light on every piece. The spec panel holds six left-aligned generic field-name rows reading name, specification, contents, product size, packaging and suitable age, while every value appears only as a placeholder 「{callout_18}」 at 13pt in #2E3A35. Centered headline 「{callout_19}」 at 34pt in #2E3A35 with a short #4E9B85 rule above the panel, and one rounded button filled {accent_color} beneath it carrying action copy 「{callout_20}」 at 18pt in #2E3A35. The kit occupies 50-60% of the frame. Negative: no invented measurements, piece count, weight, price, discount, countdown or free-gift promise, no age recommendation, no wood species or material grade, no certification, lab number or seal, no IQ or developmental-benefit wording, no duplicated or mirrored blocks, no hands, no faces, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.
shots.negativePrompt: no invented measurements, piece count, weight or set contents, no price, discount, countdown or free-gift promise, no age recommendation, no wood species or material grade, no certification, lab number or seal, no IQ or developmental-benefit wording, no duplicated or mirrored blocks, no hands, no faces, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo

provenance.notes: 由 10 屏详情页切片逐片提炼，主体一律以 {product} 占位，换成另一套实木单元积木（含带孔底板）仍可用。品类以图为准：画面主体是长条块、方块、圆柱与屋形块混装的实木单元积木，配一块带圆孔的胶合板底板，圆柱与方块插立在孔内（panel-05/06 可见孔位与木层压边），既无塑料拼桩凸点也无印刷字母面，故 L1/L2 取 taxonomy 精确串「玩具」/「益智」，leaf 落在实木单元积木＋带孔底板。屏数收敛为 11：panel-01 拆成白底主图（合规新增）＋首屏图标带，panel-04 的副标你担心的我们都懂你独立成顾虑四问卡、其证书画面只保留两个空白资质框，panel-02 与 panel-08 的对角分色工艺卡合并进结构屏与微距屏，panel-09 的多档件数信息合并为档位卡与规格表，panel-10 的尺寸行合并进收口屏。与库内三条积木版完全区隔：yuanmu-dakueli 是暖调 #FBF3E7 纸面＋#1F3A63 深蓝框带＋圆角描边大字，liumianyinhuazimu 是中调糖果 #A9DDEF/#F7F0DC＋波浪云边分隔＋#F7D948 填色描边大字，sanheyipeiduiban 是中性 #F5F4F2＋#F8D3B4 深圆角缺口面板＋六边形编号徽；本模版改为冷调薄荷体系——#CFEAD9 与 #FFFFFF 整幅硬接缝交替横带、全部文案沿竖轴居中、标题下方一条 #4E9B85 短横线、拉丁字距眉标、#4E9B85 与 #FFFFFF 对角分割面板、细线 #2E3A35 圆圈图标加直线引线胶囊标签，整组统一 6500K 冷调主光来自右上、阴影落向左下（既有版均为 5500K 左上）。镜数 11，机位角 7 类以上（正面平视微侧 18 度、高 45 度俯视、平视卡格、等距 30 度分离剖视、20 度掠射微距、侧面 90 度、仰视低角、90 度正俯平铺），含 2 镜特写/微距，全景 4/11 约 36%。已剥离：两名儿童的面部与身份（统一改为背影或下巴以上裁切，并强制成人手在画面内监护）、原页全部中文文案与 SIDE PERIMETER/MEDICAL POTECTION 等装饰字标（改写成 {selling_point_1..5} 与 {callout_1..20} 占位，只保留首屏图标带、四问卡、分层剖视、玩法阶梯、对角分色卡、空白资质框、规格表骨架）、证书画面（仅留空框，禁止生成任何证书文本、编号、印章与标志）。所有数值与安全结论一律留空由卖家填真值：适龄月龄段、颗粒数与档位件数（源页出现的任何数字均不搬用、也不改写成新数字）、底板与单块尺寸、木材树种与漆料成分；所有寓教于乐、开发智力、更聪明、脑部发育之类的发育/教育收益断言，以及环保、无毒、无异味、不伤手、安全水性漆之类的材质与安全结论，全部不写入模版并逐条落进 noDrift 与每一镜 Negative；资质屏不含任何标准名（EN71/ASTM/3C/CE）。促销位不含折扣、价格、倒计时与赠品承诺。productFamily 取最接近的 home（实木材质与工艺导向）。
